texts.text: Established in 1963 by virtue of Law No (4) of the year 1963, Qatar Chamber is considered one of the oldest chambers of commerce among GCC chambers.
It’s a non-profit public organization whose mission is to represent, support and protect the interests of the business community in Qatar.
